prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I braked as hard as I could. The vehicle coming the other way crossed into my lane and we collided head-on, though we were both moving slowly when it happened. Airbags did not deploy, and I got out of the car on my own. Within an hour I began to feel stiffness across my neck and a dull ache low in my back, which has continued since. I have described these events the same way to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff who saw me, and to the adjuster who contacted me afterward. I am the named driver on this policy and I have no other vehicles involved in this matter. I am submitting this account so my injuries and the damage to my car can be reviewed.
